profile.name: El Mahdi Bellaziz
profile.title: Cybersecurity & Full-Stack Engineer
profile.tagline: I find and fix vulnerabilities — and build secure, full-stack web & mobile apps end to end.
profile.bio:
I'm a cybersecurity engineering student and vulnerability-research engineer based in Safi, Morocco. On contract, I generate code repositories seeded with OSS-fuzz-style vulnerabilities and author the correct, validated patches used to train and evaluate frontier AI code-repair models — root-cause analysis, program repair, and differential / fuzz-based test oracles in C, C++, Python and Assembly.

Alongside security research, I build full-stack web and mobile applications end to end with Laravel, Vue / Nuxt, React and Flutter — from secure authentication and payment flows to real-time tracking systems. CCNA 1–3 certified and currently pursuing a State Engineer degree in Intelligent Networks & Cybersecurity.

experiences.description: Generate code repositories containing deliberately injected, OSS-fuzz-style vulnerabilities together with correct, ground-truth patches — used to train and evaluate frontier AI code-repair models.
highlights: Author adversarial test suites and differential / fuzz-based oracles that separate correct patches from plausible-but-wrong fixes
Validate against reference implementations over tens of thousands of cases; confirm every injected bug is independently detectable and necessary (leave-one-out)
Work across C, C++, Python and low-level targets — memory-dump recovery, VM crackmes, binary / telemetry decoders
